The ideal candidate blends analytical rigor, commercial mindset, and creative strategy, and is comfortable leading planning conversations, recommending priorities, and shaping the HSP marketing agenda. Who You Are You are a builder who enjoys creating structure where none exists. You are energized by data, curious about the K–12 landscape, and motivated by the opportunity to shape how Penn Foster grows in priority HSP states and regions. You bring strong judgment, analytical rigor, and creativity to translate insight into action. You thrive in roles where you can influence the business at scale. You like working across functions, building strategic partnerships, and helping transform market opportunities into meaningful business outcomes. You are at your best when you can bring order to complexity, create opportunity, and build something that has lasting impact. Core Responsibilities

  • Identify emerging HSP market opportunities, regional growth trends, and strategic partnership opportunities aligned to business objectives.
  • Monitor customer, competitor, workforce, school, and industry trends to inform HSP marketing and growth strategy.
  • Develop market assessments and recommendations for priority states and regions.

Business Partnership

  • Serve as the strategic marketing partner for High School Partnerships.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the HSP business, school-year cycle, counselor and school dynamics, and commercial priorities.
  • Translate business objectives into marketing recommendations and go-to-market opportunities.
  • Lead HSP marketing planning conversations with a clear point of view, agenda, and recommendation.

Strategic Planning

  • Develop annual and quarterly HSP marketing strategies aligned to commercial priorities.
  • Build state- and region-specific growth plans that support enrollment and revenue growth.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on market potential, business impact, and organizational readiness.
  • Shape conference and field engagement strategies that support HSP business goals.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, RevOps, Sales, and other internal teams to develop coordinated strategies.
  • Facilitate alignment across stakeholders to ensure HSP priorities are reflected in messaging, campaigns, and commercial programs.
  • Build relationships with external organizations, school partners, industry associations, and community stakeholders as appropriate.

Market Intelligence & Analytics

  • Analyze market trends, customer behavior, campaign performance, and commercial data to identify growth opportunities.
  • Translate quantitative and qualitative insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Build business cases supported by data, customer insight, and market understanding.

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Identification of new HSP market opportunities
  • Development of strategic growth initiatives
  • Quality of HSP market and business recommendations
  • Cross-functional alignment and stakeholder trust
  • Adoption of strategies by commercial teams
  • Growth in priority states and regions
  • Strategic partnership development
  • Commercial impact of HSP initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; background in Education, Higher Education, or a related field strongly preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in strategic marketing, product marketing, commercial strategy, market intelligence, business development, or a related function.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information into clear strategic direction.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity, establish structure, and build new capabilities from the ground up.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Commercial acumen
  • Analytical rigor
  • Customer and market insight
  • Cross-functional influence
  • Relationship building
  • Business judgment
  • Creativity and synthesis
  • Builder mindset
  • Comfort with ambiguity

Work Environment & Hiring Requirements

  • Role Assessment: Candidates will be required to complete a role-specific assessment as the first step in the hiring process. Assessment results will be used to evaluate alignment with the position and determine next steps in the process.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture when working remotely. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.

About Us: At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market. Equal Employment Opportunity: We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in. What We Offer: We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, plus free access to all of our online programs.

jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.

Discover Impactful Work:

The Director, Learning & Customer Excellence is responsible for defining and executing the learning, capability development, customer experience, and culture transformation strategy across Global Central Laboratories. The role establishes capability frameworks and role-based learning pathways for Client Delivery functions, while leading onboarding programs and customer excellence initiatives that support all Global Central Laboratories employees. This position partners with business leaders across Global Central Laboratories to improve organizational effectiveness, customer experience, employee capability, and overall business performance through scalable learning and behavioral excellence programs.

A Day in the Life:

Learning & Capability Strategy

Lead and drive capability development across Client Delivery through the following activities:

  • Define and execute the Client Delivery learning and capability strategy aligned with business priorities and customer outcomes.
  • Establish competency frameworks, proficiency standards, and capability models across Project Management, Project Design Management, and Strategic Partnership functions.
  • Define role-based learning pathways, readiness criteria, certification requirements, and development programs that support employee effectiveness and career progression.
  • Partner with Client Delivery leaders to identify capability gaps and implement targeted development strategies.
  • Ensure capability development initiatives support workforce readiness, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Align learning priorities with operational performance, customer expectations, and future organizational needs.

Learning Operations, Onboarding & Training Excellence

Lead and drive learning operations through the following activities:

  • Provide leadership and oversight for onboarding, role-based training, continuous learning programs, and capability development activities.
  • Lead the team responsible for PM, PDM, onboarding, and customer experience training programs.
  • Oversee enterprise onboarding programs that accelerate colleague readiness and reinforce Global Central Laboratories culture and customer-centric behaviors.
  • Establish governance for learning content, curriculum management, knowledge repositories, training effectiveness, and learning standards.
  • Oversee learning technologies, learning management systems, digital learning platforms, and AI-enabled learning solutions to improve scalability and effectiveness.
  • Ensure role-based training programs remain aligned to evolving business requirements, customer expectations, and operational priorities.
  • Monitor learning effectiveness and implement improvements based on learner feedback, proficiency assessments, operational performance, and business needs.

Customer Excellence & Experience

Lead and drive customer excellence initiatives across Global Central Laboratories through the following activities:

  • Define and implement the Global Central Laboratories Customer Excellence strategy.
  • Establish customer experience standards, playbooks, and behavioral expectations that reinforce accountability, ownership, and client-first decision making.
  • Lead Customer Excellence Academy programs that build customer-facing capabilities across all Global Central Laboratories functions.
  • Partner with business leaders to embed customer experience principles into onboarding, learning programs, leadership development, and operational processes.
  • Drive organizational understanding of customer impact and strengthen the connection between employee actions, customer outcomes, and patient impact.
  • Partner with operational and functional leaders to strengthen communication, issue resolution, expectation management, escalation management, and customer engagement capabilities.
  • Promote a culture that consistently prioritizes customer outcomes and strengthens client trust.

Voice of Customer & Continuous Improvement

Lead and drive customer feedback and improvement programs through the following activities:

  • Establish governance for Voice of Customer (VOC) and customer feedback programs across Global Central Laboratories.
  • Ensure customer feedback is systematically collected, analyzed, communicated, and translated into measurable improvement actions.
  • Ensure customer feedback is incorporated into learning programs, onboarding experiences, leadership development activities, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Develop mechanisms that increase visibility of customer feedback and reinforce accountability for follow-through.
  • Partner with operational leaders to prioritize improvement initiatives based on customer insights and organizational performance data.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that improve customer satisfaction, operational effectiveness, and organizational capability.

Leadership, Culture & Organizational Effectiveness

Lead and drive culture and leadership development through the following activities:

  • Develop programs that strengthen accountability, customer-centricity, communication, collaboration, and leadership effectiveness across Global Central Laboratories.
  • Increase organizational awareness of customer expectations and reinforce a culture where all functions understand their role in delivering customer outcomes.
  • Partner with senior leaders to reinforce desired behaviors and sustain organizational culture transformation initiatives.
  • Establish recognition and reinforcement mechanisms that support customer-centric and accountability-focused behaviors.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to leadership on organizational readiness, capability development, and customer experience maturity.
  • Support enterprise change management initiatives that require capability building, behavioral adoption, and stakeholder engagement.

Keys to Success:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification

Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 12+ years).

5+ years of management responsibility

Strong leadership skills

The Senior Manager, Agentic AI Delivery will be a critical leader within Ascensus’ Transformation team, accountable for end-to-end delivery of an enterprise portfolio of agentic AI initiatives from opportunity discovery and value case through design, build, launch, adoption, and measured outcomes. This role partners with executive business leaders, product and engineering teams, data/AI practitioners, and risk/compliance to design and deliver reliable, secure, and scalable AI agent solutions that materially improve customer experience, associate productivity, and operational performance. Agentic AI Program Management and Delivery

  • Portfolio ownership and roadmap: Own an enterprise portfolio of agentic AI use cases; shape multi-quarter roadmaps tied to business strategy, scalability and measurable outcomes; define success metrics (value, quality, portability) and manage trade-offs across initiatives.

  • Risk, compliance, and responsible AI: Partner with Responsible AI leader to implement controls for data handling, model/vendor risk, explainability, and operational resilience; ensure appropriate guardrails (policy, content filtering, escalation paths) for production agent use.
  • Go-live, adoption, and change leadership: Lead launch planning, training, communications, and hypercare; drive stakeholder readiness and measurable adoption; establish feedback loops and a backlog for post-launch enhancements across business units.

Executive stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and senior leaders, translating agentic AI capabilities into practical operating model changes, investment decisions, and delivery commitments.
  • Lead executive steering committees and governance forums; produce concise materials for C-suite audiences.
  • Proactively manage interlocks across IT, Operations, Service, Sales, and Produc
  • Drive vendor and platform decisions (build/buy/partner), contract scope, and performance management to ensure delivery outcomes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.

Supervision

  • Bachelor’s Degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

  • Experience leading multiple concurrent workstreams and managing complex stakeholder environments.

WHO ARE PROPHARMA?

ProPharma helps pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies make sure their products are safe, effective, and meet all the rules. They’re like the behind-the-scenes experts who help with clinical trials, regulatory paperwork, safety monitoring, and talking to health authorities like the FDA. Basically, they support companies from early research all the way to getting a drug on the market—and beyond.

MEDICAL INFORMATION AT PROPHARMA

ProPharma has more than 25 years of expertise in delivering Medical Information services to our clientele. We specialise in distributing vital information regarding our clients' healthcare products to healthcare professionals, patients, and the wider public. Our dedicated team consists of seasoned healthcare professionals (HCPs) and graduates in life sciences who function as an integral part of your team, facilitating the exchange of clinical and scientific information related to drugs and devices, as well as product safety. Medical Information is a vital component that ensures the safe and effective use of healthcare products, supports healthcare professionals in their practice, and helps pharmaceutical and biotech companies comply with regulatory requirements.

Our innovative, market-leading technologies, and 24/7/365 contact centers allow us to provide best-in-class medical information services.

‘A DAY IN THE LIFE’ OF A MULTILINGUAL MEDICAL INFORMATION SPECIALIST

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Responding to medical and safety-related enquiries from healthcare professionals, patients, and consumers via phone, email, and web platforms.
  • Using approved product information, scientific literature, and internal data to provide clear, accurate responses.
  • Documenting and reporting adverse events, product complaints, and other safety concerns in line with regulatory standards.
  • Logging all enquiries into internal systems in a clear, timely, and compliant manner.
  • Supporting the quality of the service by performing checks on safety reports and medical enquiries.
  • Writing high-quality custom medical responses when needed, based on client-approved resources.
  • Providing informal training or mentorship to new team members as you develop in the role.
  • Contributing to process improvements and suggesting updates to internal procedures.
  • Occasionally participating in after-hours coverage on a rotating basis, based on business needs.

What You’ll Bring:

  • A degree in life sciences or healthcare-related field.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
  • An interest in drug safety, medical information, or regulatory affairs.
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to learn.
  • Fluency (C1) in German and English both written and orally.

WHAT PROPHARMA CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Unrivalled career development – more than 95% of Medical Information leadership roles are filled internally.
  • Remote working – with over 85% of our workforce successfully working from home, we can offer a flexible, home-based working arrangement.
  • Continued learning and development – comprehensive onboarding and full training for all roles, including a dedicated internal training team who can offer leadership and management training, industry training and the opportunity to learn from the wider MI Team by tapping into their invaluable knowledge.
  • Performance-related pay, annual bonus and benefits – our comprehensive benefits package includes health & wellness support, contributary pension scheme, enhanced maternity leave and much more!

What You'll Do

  • Owning technical onboarding for new customers — partnering with the assigned CXM to scope a plan, then handling SDK implementation, integration, data mapping, and event tracking so every account starts off on solid ground

What We Are Looking For

  • You have a curious mind and a desire to learn — you might not have all the answers, but you're eager to dig in and find them

  • You like empowering customers with the tools and knowledge to build things themselves in the future, not just fixing things for them

  • You love collaboration. You want to work closely with CXMs and Product to do what's right for the customer and the company

  • You're an A+ communicator who can translate technical detail into something a non-technical stakeholder can act on — and translate customer feedback into something Product and Engineering can act on, too

  • You're comfortable owning ambiguity, whether that's scoping a new engagement, triaging an urgent issue, or working toward a fix with incomplete information

  • You're driven and organized — juggling onboarding, premium services work, and live support escalations all at once takes real focus and follow-through

POSITION OVERVIEW

jobs.description:
ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire a QA Automation Engineer to join our team.

Agencies use ClassWallet to get public funds to the right people, and ensure the funds are used for the right purpose. ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. ClassWallet has processed over $6.7 Billion to date and serves public agencies across 39 states. In its 11+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280+ full-time staff.

The Company has developed an industry-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023.

While the Company delivers immense business value, the social impact of ClassWallet is a fabric that runs through its mission and corporate culture. As a result of ClassWallet’s innovation, public programs run with exponentially more efficiency and the impact and breadth of the programs for the individuals they serve is dramatically higher. This mission compliments the Company mission-based culture with focus on gratitude and work-life balance.

About the Role

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer who combines strong manual testing skills with experience in test automation to help build quality into the software delivery process. This role is ideal for someone who believes quality is a shared team responsibility that starts when requirements are being written. They will contribute to building testing practices that ensure fast, reliable, and continuous delivery of high-quality software.

The right candidate will have a shift-left mindset, working closely with product managers, developers, and other QA engineers to identify risks early, improve test coverage, and embed quality into the entire SDLC.

Responsibilities

  • Execute high-level manual exploratory testing for new features while simultaneously building out automated test scripts for long-term stability
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites using frameworks such as Playwright or Selenium
  • Participate actively in agile ceremonies providing the “QA voice” to keep the team focused on quality deliverables.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to clarify acceptance criteria and testability
  • Perform exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues
  • Analyze test results, identify bugs, and work closely with developers for timely resolution.
  • Investigate defects, help isolate root causes, and work with engineering teams to ensure resolution
  • Advocate for shift-left testing practices and continuous improvement in quality processes.

Requirements

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance with a focus on automation
  • Experience performing both manual and automated testing
  • Proficiency with automation tools such as Playwright or Selenium
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Expertise with at least one programming/scripting language
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies with a Shift-Left mindset.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber)
  • Familiarity with performance or integration testing
  • Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail)
  • Knowledge of API testing tools

Benefits

ClassWallet is a positive, family-oriented team environment. Our focus is on encouragement, positive reinforcement, and gratitude. We work hard and are highly motivated to win but with a healthy perspective on life.

We offer an excellent salary and benefits commensurate with experience.

ClassWallet.com is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status.

Це роль для людини, яка хоче не просто виконувати задачі, а впливати на продукт, процеси та бізнес-результати.

Тому ми створюємо середовище, де люди можуть будувати продукти, брати відповідальність і зростати разом із бізнесом.

Build.
Тебе очікує на цій ролі:

  • Експерименти з AI та сучасними арт-інструментами.
  • Розробка й оптимізація production-пайплайнів.
  • Робота на стику творчості та технологій у тісній співпраці з Tech Lead і продуктовою командою.
Own.
Тобі потрібно для досягнення результату:
  • Комерційний досвід від 3 років на позиції 2D Artist, Concept Artist, Tech Artist або суміжних ролях.
  • Високий рівень володіння Adobe Photoshop та/або Clip Studio Paint.
  • Практичний досвід роботи з генеративними AI-інструментами (ComfyUI, Leonardo, WaveSpeed або аналогами) та prompt engineering.
  • Сильна база в академічному малюнку: композиція, колористика, анатомія, стилізація.
  • Досвід ручного доопрацювання AI-генерацій (overpaint, retouch).
  • Розуміння сучасних 2D/3D пайплайнів, досвід роботи з Blender буде перевагою.
  • Вміння швидко досліджувати нові інструменти, тестувати гіпотези та інтегрувати їх у робочі процеси.
  • Самостійність, проактивність та бажання постійно експериментувати.
Grow.
Твої зони відповідальності та зростання:
  • Створення великого обсягу якісного графічного контенту та апселів для платформи з вертикальними серіалами.
  • Дослідження, тестування та впровадження нових AI-рішень і production-пайплайнів.
  • Оптимізація процесів створення графіки та автоматизація рутинних задач.
  • Тісна співпраця з Tech Lead над експериментами та розвитком нових підходів до виробництва контенту.
  • Документування знайдених рішень і передача нових практик арт-команді.
  • Вплив на якість, швидкість виробництва та масштабування арт-процесів продукту.
Що ми пропонуємо в Honeytech:
  • Робота над digital entertainment продуктами № 1 в індустрії вебкоміксів
  • Класна команда, яку об’єднують амбіції, розвиток та бажання досягати результатів.
  • Робота з найбільш конкурентними ринками світу: Tier-1, LatAm та Європа.

  • Корпоративні подорожі, святкування, командні зустрічі та внутрішні ініціативи.
Турбота про твій комфорт:
  • Віддалена робота або можливість працювати з офісу в Києві.
  • Гнучкий графік та можливість самостійно планувати свій робочий день.
  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки та 30 днів sick leave.
  • Медичне страхування та покриття консультацій із корпоративним психологом.
  • HoneyFit — компенсація спортивних активностей, тренувань та спортивних подій.

  • Підтримка релокації, компенсація коворкінгів та допомога з облаштуванням комфортного робочого місця.
Якщо тобі близький підхід Build. Own. Grow.— будемо раді познайомитися.

About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!

Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.

At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.

Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.

The Air Coordinator is responsible for managing global air services operations, including ticketing, exchanges, refunds, and schedule changes, while ensuring timely and accurate processing. This role supports Sales and Private Group teams to grow air attachment and acts as the primary liaison with regional airline partners. It also ensures compliance with airline policies, supports after-hours emergency services, and contributes to operational efficiency through vendor collaboration, process optimization, and interdepartmental teamwork.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Ticketing and Airline Coordination: Action all global air services and support, including ticketing, exchanges/re-issues, schedule changes, and refunds.

  • Daily Queue Management: Ensure all tickets due are processed and issued daily, while responding to all internal and external emails in a timely manner.

  • Policy Compliance: Stay fully informed of all changing airline rules and regulations, ensuring proactive follow-up with airlines on authorizations and problem file solutions.

  • Sales Enablement: Assist the Inside Sales team with developing a culture and confidence in selling flights alongside our tours to help drive attachment rates.

  • System Ownership: Act as the primary point of contact for all G Air matters, including our Internal Booking Engine and any air project-related developments.

  • Emergency & After-Hours Support: Work according to the standard local office work schedule with occasional after-hours/weekend emergency support to handle urgent, last-minute passenger changes and maintain continuous operation outside of regular hours.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Minimum 1-year experience in a fast-paced customer service and travel sales environment.

  • Systems Expertise: Prior experience and advanced technical skills using the Amadeus Cryptic system (specifically managing PNRs, Fares, Ticketing, Exchanges, and Refunds across BSP/ARC).

  • Technical Literacy: Confident using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel), Google Workspace (Gmail/Drive), and a proven ability to learn new internal booking software quickly.

  • Communication: Customer-service focused (both internal and external) with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Working Styles & Mental Effort: A self-motivator who excels at multi-tasking and prioritizing duties in a highly organized manner with sharp attention to detail. You must be comfortable managing the occasional mental fatigue that comes with handling high-intensity, time-sensitive tasks like major airline schedule changes or urgent, last-minute passenger disruptions.

Additional Information

  • Base Salary Hiring Range: $41,000.00 - $52,500.00 CAD annually

What Do We Offer You?

  • Competitive Total Rewards Package, including exclusive travel perks!

  • Additional days off, including on your birthday!

  • Vacation time for you to recharge

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Meaningful Employee Recognition Program

  • Learning and Growth Opportunities

  • Employee Resource Groups

*Applicable based on location*

Please note that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is used in the selection or interview process.

G Adventures is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants.

  • Manage and coordinate the HSE Champion network across Capabilities

  • Improved HSE compliance and CDM governance maturity across Capabilities

  • Reduced risk exposure and strengthened control effectiveness

  • APS membership strongly preferred

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, data and operational teams, acting as a subject matter expert for your product stream while also coaching and supporting Product Managers within your area

  • Support and coach Product Managers, helping them grow capability, confidence and ownership.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, tailoring messages to technical and non technical audiences.
  • Contribute to building a high performing, customer obsessed product culture.

  • Proven experience as a Senior Product Manager delivering complex, customer facing digital products.
  • Strong experience working in a product centric, agile environment with cross functional teams.
  • A customer first mindset, with hands on experience in user research and customer engagement.
  • Confidence using data to guide decisions, prioritisation and performance measurement.
  • Experience defining and delivering against product OKRs and strategic objectives.
  • Ability to manage and communicate a product roadmap with clarity and impact.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including presenting to senior leaders.
  • Experience supporting, mentoring or leading other Product Managers.
  • Naturally curious, analytical and outcomes focused, with a bias for action.

Evri Group for everyone

In this role, you will lead process development initiatives, maintain and improve the process of record (POR) for production, and collaborate closely with foundry partners. You will play a key role in advancing next-generation superconducting technologies in a highly innovative environment.

Our proprietary fabrication platform features advanced capabilities, including multiple critical current density (Jc) targets, seven wiring layers, planarized dielectrics, 0.25 µm features, and submicron Josephson junctions. Our processors integrate over one million Josephson junctions, representing some of the most complex superconducting circuits ever built. This role offers the opportunity to develop processes at the forefront of semiconductor innovation.

What you'll do

  • Design, execute, and analyze experiments using statistical methods to improve process performance and yield
  • Own and optimize critical fabrication steps or modules within the process flow
  • Maintain and enhance the process of record (POR) for production

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (design, device, reliability) to meet product requirements
  • Collaborate with foundries to troubleshoot issues and implement process improvements in production
  • Document and standardize processes, specifications, and control plans

  • 10+ years of experience in process integration (preferred)
  • Strong knowledge of semiconductor fabrication processes, including thin film deposition, lithography, etch, diffusion, wet processing, and CMP
  • Experience in LSI manufacturing or semiconductor R&D (strongly preferred)
  • Solid understanding of process integration, yield, performance, and reliability interactions
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment and meet deadlines
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.

Remote role in the US, Canada or Europe

Role Overview 🚀

At Uncapped, we help ambitious founders realize their dreams. Acquisition today is concentrated heavily on a single channel, and our outbound motion isn't set up to change that: sending infrastructure is misconfigured, deliverability is inconsistent, and the tools meant to power outbound duplicate each other instead of working as one system. As our GTM Engineer, you'll own outbound end to end and build it into a real engine: cold email, LinkedIn and signal based prospecting running at scale, on infrastructure that's actually built to hold up.

This is a build from the ground up role. You'll be the person who takes a fragmented, underperforming outbound motion and turns it into a coherent, multi channel engine. You'll work cross functionally with SDRs, AEs, RevOps and Partnerships to develop plays that plug straight into that engine, not around it.

About Uncapped 👫

Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a leading fintech provider of working & growth capital to e-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e-commerce platforms — including Amazon and Walmart — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

What you will do ✍️

You will own outbound end to end for Uncapped, from infrastructure and deliverability through to the tools and data that decide who we reach and how.

  • Outbound infrastructure: Design and build scalable systems for prospecting, enrichment and outreach, owning the technical backbone of our outbound motion from data pipelines to automation workflows.
  • SDR enablement and optimization: Equip our SDRs with world class tooling, playbooks and data insights to maximize efficiency and conversion rates across the funnel.
  • Data and targeting strategy: Build ICP models, scoring frameworks and segmentation logic to ensure outbound efforts are laser focused on high intent, high fit accounts.
  • Tech stack ownership: Evaluate, implement and optimize our GTM tools (CRM, sequencing, enrichment, intent data) to create a seamless, high performance outbound engine.
  • Performance analytics: Track, analyze and report on outbound metrics, from reply rates to pipeline contribution, and drive continuous improvement through experimentation and iteration.
  • Cross functional alignment: Work with SDRs, AEs, RevOps and Partnerships to ensure outbound systems integrate seamlessly with broader GTM strategy and product capabilities.

Requirements

Who you are 👀

  • 4+ years of experience
  • A tooling expert: opinionated about best in class GTM tech stacks and experienced evaluating, implementing and optimizing tools that drive outbound performance at scale
  • Hands on and resourceful: comfortable shifting between high level strategy and execution, from designing data models to writing SQL queries or automation scripts yourself
  • Highly analytical and creative: able to blend technical problem solving with strategic thinking about go to market efficiency and scale
  • Someone who cares deeply about craft and impact, not just output. You take pride in doing great work, even on small details
  • Curious and collaborative: eager to learn from teammates across functions and energized by talking to SDRs and AEs to understand their workflows and build systems that drive results

Benefits

What we offer 🎁

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We are a start-up with big goals, and we work hard, so we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. We are continually adding to this list as new people join -- here are some of the things you can expect:

  • Unlimited holiday: we believe that well-rested and happy people make the best employees
  • Competitive compensation plan
  • Personal growth fund: Raise your game from great to spectacular
  • Monthly recognition and awards: Celebrate wins big and small
  • The opportunity to make a big impact every day on the lives of European and US entrepreneurs.
  • Optional workspaces in Warsaw, London and Atlanta

We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA, Canada or Europe without requiring visa sponsorship.

jobs.description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Role Summary

This role sits within a strategic investment to embed AI into how we operate, serve customers, and make decisions within our healthcare business. We're building a healthcare-wide AI data and context platform with a focus on deep domain expertise embedded throughout our architecture. Our goals are:

Turn structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable "building blocks" (semantic layers, retrieval services, and agent-ready interfaces) that accelerate product innovation

Deliver transformational speed and leverage — faster time-to-insight, higher automation of knowledge work, and a foundation that scales AI safely and reliably as adoption grows

Unlock new capabilities across our business and create the foundation that drives deeper domain innovation and cross-domain collaboration

This is a hands-on technical contributor who builds and maintains core AI/context data capabilities. The role executes key parts of the AI context platform — unstructured ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and semantic layers — working closely with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to ship reliable, production-grade AI data products.

Key Responsibilities

Build and contribute to the AI context platform

  • Implement end-to-end pipelines: ingestion → parsing/chunking → enrichment → embeddings → vector indexing → retrieval/serving

  • Build andmaintainpatterns for incremental refresh, backfills, re-embeddings, deduplication, and lineage across unstructured sources

  • Contribute to retrieval quality improvements (query strategies, hybrid search, metadata filtering) in partnership with AI engineers

Deliver semantic and governed data products

  • Implement semantic layers (metrics/entities) that power BI and agent reasoning consistently

  • Apply established data contracts and context contracts for AI inputs (schemas, metadata requirements, freshness, citation expectations)

  • Ensure datasets and indexes are documented and reusable

Operational excellence

  • Support reliability and performance across assigned workstreams: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and incident response

  • Contribute to cost and latency optimization across warehouse/lakehouseand vector infrastructure

AI safety and compliance

  • Apply security-by-design patterns: RBAC/ABAC, PII redaction, retention controls, and audit logging

  • Follow established guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge in coordination with Security/Legal/Compliance

Travel Expectations

  • Ability to travel as needed up to 4 times per year.

Required Qualifications

  • BA or BS required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a technology-based discipline

  • 3–6 years in data engineering or data platform roles with strong hands-on delivery

  • Strong SQL and Python (or Scala/Java); solid production engineering habits

  • Experience designing and operating cloud data pipelines at scale

  • Experience working with unstructured data processing and search/retrieval concepts

  • Clear communicator who can work effectively across technical and functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with vector search and embeddings (pgvector/Pinecone/Weaviate/OpenSearch/Elastic) and retrieval patterns (semantic retrieval, hybrid search, reranking)

  • Experience supporting LLM applications (RAG, agent tool interfaces, evaluation/observability)

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs/semantic modeling or metrics layers

  • Experience in regulated environments and data governance programs

Example Success Measures

  • Measurable improvement in AI outcomes: higher retrieval precision/recall, better citation coverage, fewer "missing context" failures

  • Reduced latency/cost per retrieval and improved platform reliability (SLO attainment, lower MTTR)

  • Consistent application of semantic definitions and context contracts across assigned workstreams

  • Delivery quality: production-ready outputs with minimal rework, well-documented and maintainable

Behavioral Attributes

  • Eager to learn the domain:Proactively builds familiarity with healthcare processes, terminology, and KPIs — can engage credibly with SMEs and ask the right clarifying questions

  • Collaborative and stakeholder-aware:Works well with engineers, consultants, and functional partners; communicates progress and flags risks clearly

  • Consultative problem-solver:Approaches requests with a "diagnose before prescribe" mindset — proposes options and works toward durable solutions rather than one-off fixes

  • High ownership and follow-through:Treats reliability, documentation, and operational readiness as part of the work; finishes what they start; holds a high bar for production quality

  • Clear communicator:Can go deep with engineers and explain concepts plainly to non-technical partners; writes solid docs and runbooks

  • Pragmatic builder:Biases toward shipping value in iterations,validatingwith users, and improving based on feedback

  • Comfortable with ambiguity:Adapts quickly in evolving AI/data product environments and turns unclear goals into actionable tasks

  • Integrity and stewardship:Handles sensitive data responsibly and respectsestablishedgovernance patterns

jobs.excerpt: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
jobs.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical, customer-obsessed Lead Solution Engineer to join our global technical operations team.

This is a premier role designed for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of deep technical problem-solving and direct client consultation. While you will support our diverse, global network of premium publishers, you will also serve as the critical technical lead for our rapidly expanding Brazilian market.

You won't be hiding behind a ticketing system; you will be the face of our technical expertise, working directly with our customers to solve their most complex technical challenges and seamlessly guide them through the adoption of our advanced ad-tech products. Because of this strategic focus, native or professional fluency in Portuguese is required, alongside excellent English communication skills to bridge the gap between our Brazilian customers and our global internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

1. Customer-Facing Problem Solving & Adoption

  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Act as the primary technical escalation point for our premium global publishers. Dive deep into code, network traffic, and ad server configurations to diagnose and resolve integration issues.
  • Brazilian Market Champion: Serve as the trusted technical partner for our Brazilian customers, leading implementation calls, troubleshooting sessions, and product walkthroughs fluently in Portuguese.
  • Technical Onboarding: Lead the end-to-end technical implementation of MonetizeMore's proprietary tools (like PubGuru and Advanced Ads) for high-value accounts, ensuring customers experience zero downtime and optimal revenue performance from day one.
  • Custom Code Solutions: Write and debug custom JavaScript, HTML, and API integrations to adapt our monetization solutions to the unique setups of customer websites and mobile apps.

2. Driving Product Value & Communication

  • Strategic Consultations: Partner with global Business Development and Account Management teams to evaluate a customer’s setup, proactively recommending configurations that unlock higher ad revenue.
  • The Technical Translator: Translate highly complex ad-tech concepts (e.g., Header Bidding, Open Bidding, Core Web Vitals) into clear, actionable value propositions for non-technical customers and business owners.
  • Product Feedback Loop: Act as the bridge between our global clients and internal Product/Engineering teams. Translate real-world customer friction points and feature requests into structured technical requirements to influence our global product roadmap.

Who You Are

  • The Customer-Facing Engineer: You have 5+ years of experience in a highly technical, client-facing role (e.g., Solution Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or a Support Engineer who works directly with customers).
  • Linguistic Capability: You are completely fluent in Portuguese (both written and spoken) and comfortable guiding Brazilian customers through technical solutions, regardless of their technical background. You also possess excellent English skills for internal global collaboration.
  • Web Tech Master: You have strong, practical knowledge of front-end web technologies: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS, and HTTP/Network protocols. You know exactly how to use Chrome DevTools to debug script execution, layout shifts, and page latency.
  • Ad Tech Exposure (Highly Preferred): Prior experience with Google Ad Manager (GAM), Prebid.js, Header Bidding, SDK integrations, or Google Publisher Tags (GPT) will make you a standout candidate.
  • The Empathetic Problem-Solver: You possess a rare blend of technical curiosity and strong communication skills. You know how to calm a frustrated customer, build trust, and methodically break down a vague bug report into a clear technical fix.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an autonomous schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

Assessment Requirement: As part of our hiring process, all applicants who pass the resume screening will be required to complete a TestDome assessment. Only candidates who successfully pass the assessment will be invited to proceed to the Culture Fit Interview.

Do you have experience with BeyondTrust Endpoint Security?

Join a global, product‑led tech company as a Contract Security Engineer focused on Privileged Access and Endpoint Privilege Management. You’ll sit within the central Security / Identity & Access Management (IAM) function and take ownership of deploying and configuring a new BeyondTrust EPM solution across the organization.

You’ll be part of a small, specialist squad (Security + IT) driving a phased rollout, defining and tuning policies, automating where possible, and helping to establish best practices that will be adopted by IT, business teams, and a large engineering organisation.

This is an initial 6‑month B2B engagement with a potential for extension.

Your Tasks Will Include:

  • Lead the deployment and configuration of BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) across the organization
  • Design, implement, and fine‑tune EPM policies, rules, and configurations for different user groups and environments
  • Work with Security / IAM / IT to plan and execute a phased rollout with early adopters, business teams, and then engineering
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to gather feedback on the rollout and adjust policies and settings accordingly
  • Create and maintain documentation which includes configuration guides, runbooks, deployment procedures, and best practices
  • Contribute to testing and validation of EPM policies to minimise user disruption while maintaining strong security controls
  • Identify opportunities to automate deployment, configuration, and ongoing management (e.g. via scripting in PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.)
  • Monitor progress against agreed project timelines and milestones, escalating risks or blockers when needed
  • Work closely with the wider Identity & Access Management team to align EPM configuration with existing IAM standards and processes
  • Provide knowledge sharing and basic enablement to internal teams on how to work effectively with the new EPM solution

To be a good fit for the Security Engineer role, you will have:

  • Minimum of 1 years experience deploying, configuring, and managing policies with BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) in a production environment
  • Good understanding of identity and access management concepts, particularly for human identities and endpoint controls
  • Proven ability to design, implement, and tune security policies for different user groups (IT, business users, engineers) while balancing usability and security
  • Practical experience working with IT, security, or IAM teams in a corporate environment
  • Scripting and/or automation skills in at least one language (e.g. PowerShell, Bash, Python or similar), used to support deployment, configuration, or ongoing management
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation (configuration, runbooks, guidelines, best practices)
  • Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written
  • Proactive, ownership‑driven working style, able to drive tasks independently once goals and direction are set

Nice to have

  • Experience with .NET and full‑stack development (back‑end, front‑end, DevOps) and interest in contributing more broadly to engineering work if the contract is extended
  • Experience with Azure and automation around cloud or endpoint tooling
  • Approximately 1–2+ years working with similar EPM/PAM solution (One Identity or CyberArk)

What’s in it for you:

  • Impact from day one where you’ll own a high‑visibility security project, rolling out a new Endpoint Privilege Management platform that directly improves the organisation’s security posture.
  • Hands‑on work with BeyondTrust EPM, with the freedom to influence how it’s implemented, configured, and operated.
  • Work fully remotely from Poland with a B2B contract, with only occasional in‑person meetings if needed.
  • Work in a small, focused squad with direct access to decision‑makers, minimising bureaucracy and helping you move quickly.

What Clinical Operations does at Worldwide

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we invite you to embark on a rewarding journey within Clinical Operations, where your contributions will leave a profound impact on the lives of patients.

As a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) at Worldwide, you will find yourself working alongside brilliant minds across diverse therapeutic areas, including Cardiovascular, Metabolic, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Rare Diseases. Collaboration with top-tier colleagues from various backgrounds and specialties is not just encouraged; it's ingrained in our culture. Our commitment to advancing clinical research is nurtured within a supportive and team-oriented environment. In a CRA role, you'll receive extensive support through regulatory submissions, TMF management, and in-house CRAs for projects with heavy site management needs.

Through regular touchpoints and coaching conversations with your Line Manager, we ensure that your professional development remains a top priority. We offer a clear career path and development that can lead to Clinical Trial Manager roles. We take pride in our accessible Executive Leadership team, who are equally committed to advancing science and surmounting obstacles to make a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

We offer an unparalleled experience, where you can drive remarkable scientific breakthroughs and be at the very core of every successful clinical trial. Experience a world of difference with us at Worldwide!

What you will do

  • Responsible for managing the research activities at sites participating in Worldwide’s clinical research projects

  • Typically involved in all stages of the clinical study, including identifying potential sites to participate in the research effort, performing various study start-up activities such as working with sites to collect appropriate regulatory documents and supporting the negotiation of contracts and budgets, training the sites to collect data properly and report any potential safety-related events, managing the site's activities during study maintenance, and closing down research activities at the sites once the study has concluded

  • Superior organizational skills with attention to detail

  • Ability to work with little or no supervision

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS, and EDC Systems

Your experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate

  • 4-year university degree OR Nursing Degree

  • Experience in CNS/Neurology is required; Psychiatry is strongly preferred

  • Candidates must reside on the Northeastern United States

  • Willingness to travel regionally required

ROLE SUMMARY

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Pfizer, a global leader in the biopharmaceutical industry, is continuously seeking top talent who are inspired by our purpose to innovate to bring therapies to patients that significantly improve their lives.

Our Health and Science System Specialists Team provides leadership across patient care settings in the complex Hospital, Health System, and Key Medical Group environment to bring value to our customers and patients in this dynamic ecosystem.

The Health and Science System Specialist (HSSS) is responsible for launching new products, deciding on optimal strategies for managing business relationships, understanding formulary access, and engaging in product promotion within assigned accounts. In addition, the rep is charged with sales efforts and relationship development with assigned customers and accounts, including Therapeutic Area Specialists and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

The HSSS should possess customer, market and business acumen combined with strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate strong sales, promotional and strategic business development and management skills and in-depth customer engagement expertise in both virtual and in-person settings, utilize a systematic approach to virtual engagement (e.g., clear agenda, next steps/follow ups); have outstanding communications skills and be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools/multi-platforms skills; with the ability to effectively work remotely in coordination with cross-functional internal teams to address customer needs and compliantly deliver on Pfizer business objectives.

• Health Systems and their Affiliates, including, but not limited to, Academic Medical Centers, Medical Groups, Centers of Excellence and Community Hospitals
• Scaled account-based medical groups and institutions, including but not limited to, Medical Groups, Community Hospitals and Hospital Systems

Able to use triaging protocols and digital apps to create rapid connections with appropriate SMEs to address customer inquiries

• Bachelor’s Degree

  • Minimum 3 years of previous pharmaceutical biotech or medical marketing/promotional/sales, or relevant experience
    • Have a history of marketing, promotional or sales success, strong territory management skills, outstanding communications skills, as well as demonstrated teamwork, leadership ability and accountability
    • Must live within 25 miles of the border of the territory

The Student Financial Service Counselor is a student-centered services position providing an extremely high level of customer service to students, families and prospective students. The Student Financial Service Counselor is the content expert on federal, state and institutional financial applications and awards, eligibility criteria, payment options and processing. This position services enrolled and prospective students, and other college staff on the financial aid applications process and financial aid policies, making the overall experience as seamless as possible. This role is responsible for reviewing and verifying student eligibility for various aid programs, calculating funding, and explaining financial aid awards to students. The role also includes providing excellent customer service, managing incoming application files, monitoring student enrollment and financial records, and assisting with scholarship and financial aid grant program communication. Additionally, the job requires researching and analyzing student financial histories and participating in office meetings and activities. This position will also coordinate with other departments and satellite locations within the College to promote communication and information about programs and services in a professional and organized work environment.

This position primarily supports our online/virtual campus.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Provide counseling by explaining financial aid award packages based on specific program eligibility and total award amounts; reviews and verifies initial and incoming request to review student eligibility receiving various aid program funds; identifies award availability through various sources; calculate various funding to create a total financial aid award explanation; coordinates all incoming request, including documentation submission.
  2. Monitors student enrollment, explaining the recalculation of awards when necessary.
  3. Assists with Student Financial Services presentations as needed to assist with the understanding of office practices such as general guidance of federal, state and institutional aid programs.
  4. Leads and Conducts virtual FAFSA Events
  5. Conduct individual interviews and information sessions with potential and current students/families to accurately inform them of all financial aid options and opportunities, requirements, and the application process, requirements, and payment options to resolve balances.
  6. Researches, verifies, analyzes, and assesses student financial histories, including defaulted loans and/or repayment obligations at other institutions.
  7. Assists with explaining Title IV refunds and repayments, including U.S. Department of Education and National Student Loan Data Systems notifications.
  8. Assist in the processing of the FAFSA and other required documents.
  9. Review financial aid applications for accuracy.
  10. Initiate and conduct follow-up activities to obtain necessary documentation and paperwork for all federal and state funding agencies.
  11. Assist the Associate Director of Student Accounts for Student Financial Services with outreach for collection of past-due accounts.
  12. Assist students who are veterans or their dependents in completing their certificate of eligibility and/or other required documentation to obtain entitled benefits.
  13. Participates as a member of the Office of Student Financial Services during meetings, College events, and other activities.
  14. Process cash, checks, credit and debit cards payment transactions.
  15. Maintain current knowledge of federal and state regulations.
  16. Perform all other duties as assigned.

  2. Ability to provide an extremely high level of customer service.

intro

As our Marketing Associate - Affiliate marketing for one of our key insurance partnerships, you will be responsible for managing the existing affiliate network as well as onboarding new affiliates into the network. You’ll manage the day-to-day relationship with affiliates in German and English.

This is a flexible, mini-job role (around ~5 hours/week) on a one-year contract.

This position offers hands-on ownership of an established partnership within our marketing team - a great fit if you like working independently and delivering steady, dependable results.

At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer.

why work at feather?

  • We’re small, lean, and we love what we do. The usual buzzwords here, except we actually mean them. Staying small helps us focus on what matters, and we want to keep it that way.
  • You’ll work on a product that is loved by customers. Our excellent Trustpilot and Google reviews speak for themselves.
  • There's plenty of space to grow. We trust you to take ownership and make decisions from day one, and we will give you all the support and mentorship you need to succeed.
  • Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment with an office in Berlin. We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together.

what you bring to the table

  • You have some experience in affiliate marketing, partnership management, or a similar relationship-focused role.
  • You're comfortable maintaining relationships day-to-day over email, calls, and video calls.
  • You're comfortable using everyday software tools (Slack, Notion, Google Suite, and similar) and can pick up new tools quickly.
  • You're someone who takes initiative and can manage your own workload independently, without needing close supervision once you're settled in.
  • You're fluent in German and English.

you'll be responsible for

  • You will manage our existing affiliate network for this partnership, in German and English, acting as the main point of contact for day-to-day questions and onboarding new affiliates as they join.
  • You will build and maintain strong relationships with our affiliates to keep the partnership running smoothly.
  • You will monitor affiliate performance and flag issues early, sharing clear, simple reporting with the team.
  • You will use good judgment to know when to handle something directly versus when to escalate without needing close supervision.
  • You will handle commission payments, as well as regular financial reporting and reconciliation for the partnership, keeping records accurate and up to date.

what will the interview process look like?

  1. CV screening
  2. Initial video call - We’ll have a chat and get to know each other (25min)
  3. Take-home task - We'll give you a task to work on, which will give you an idea of the type of projects you'd take on at Feather (2-3h)

  5. Expectations & alignment conversation - A conversation with the Head of Marketing to align on expectations, ways of working, and next steps, including a review of insights from the previous interviews (30min)

does this sound like a good fit for you? apply now!

At Feather, we actively foster inclusive representation within our teams and embrace a diverse mix of talent. We encourage applicants from all educational paths to apply: we believe that what you’ve built, worked on, and achieved is far more important than on-paper qualifications.

jobs.description:
Шукаємо Middle Affiliate Manager, який готовий взяти ownership за розвиток партнерської мережі. Тут ти працюватимеш із Tier-1 ринками, матимеш багато автономії, впливатимеш на бізнес-результат і масштабуватимеш affiliate-напрямок разом із командою.

Honeytech — це динамічний, швидкозростаючий проєкт, що вже займає одну з лідерських позицій у світі вебкоміксів. За останні 3 роки ми зібрали команду сильних спеціалістів, з якими виросли у 10+ разів та плануємо вирости ще втричі цього року, тому саме зараз шукаємо нового амбітного та проактивного колегу. Вже зараз ми займаємо провідні позиції за обсягом трафіку, і попереду — ще більші цілі!

Що чекає на тебе з нами?

  • 📈 Реальний вплив на розвиток affiliate-напрямку: ти не просто працюватимеш із партнерами, а зможеш впливати на розвиток процесів, запускати нові ініціативи, знаходити додаткові точки росту та разом із командою масштабувати напрямок.

  • 🚀 Можливість швидкого кар'єрного зростання: ми активно масштабуємо affiliate-напрямок, тому тут є простір для розвитку, розширення зони відповідальності та кар’єрного росту разом із бізнесом.

  • 🧠 Сильна команда однодумців: співпрацюй з досвідченими фахівцями, які мають сильну експертизу в перфоманс маркетингу, дата аналітиці, розвитку діджитал продуктів та у створенні візуального контенту.
    🤩Пряма комунікація та прозорі процеси: ми любимо здоровий глузд більше, ніж заплутані процедури та уникаємо зайву бюрократію.

  • 📊 Аналітика на вищому рівні: маємо налаштовану систему аналітичних репортів, що дозволяє приймати data-driven рішення правильно та своєчасно.

Наш ідеальний Affiliate Manager має:

— 2+ роки досвіду в Affiliate Marketing;

— Досвід роботи з affiliate-партнерами: пошук, онбординг, розвиток та масштабування;
— Хороше розуміння трекінгу (створення офферів, налаштування postback, attribution models);
— Розуміння різних джерел трафіку (social, native, push, pop, search тощо);

– Вміння аналізувати ефективність партнерів через EPC, CR, CPA, ROI.
— Англійська на рівні B2+ для роботи з міжнародними партнерами;

Твоя зона відповідальності:

— Пошук, залучення та розвиток affiliate-партнерів: ресерч, переговори, онбординг і побудова довгострокових відносин.
— Супровід партнерів: допомога із запуском, робота з оферами, лінками, трекінгом і вирішення поточних питань.
— Аналіз ефективності партнерів: моніторинг ключових метрик (CR, EPC, CPA тощо), пошук точок росту та масштабування.
— Контроль якості трафіку, коректності трекінгу та дотримання домовленостей.
— Ведення CRM, звітності та документації, щоб усі процеси залишались прозорими й структурованими.
— Тісна взаємодія з командами аналітики, дизайну та розробки для запуску й розвитку партнерських інтеграцій.
— Використання AI та сучасних інструментів для ресерчу, автоматизації процесів, комунікації та підвищення ефективності роботи.

Твій шлях до нас:

Спілкування з рекрутером >> інтерв’ю з Affiliate Manager >> тестове завдання >> фінальне інтерв’ю за результатами тестового.

Далі збираємо рекомендації з твого попереднього місця роботи та ти отримуєш свій Job Offer!

Цікаво, що ще пропонуємо?

— Робота на найбільш конкурентних ринках Tier1 (США, Канада, Британія, Австралія і т.д), що дозволяє стати експертом у своїй справі.
— Віддалена робота або можливість працювати з нашого офісу в Києві + можливість користуватися офісом у Львові та коворкінгом у Варшаві.
— 20 робочих днів відпустки на рік (після 3 місяців співпраці) та до 30 днів sick leave з медичним підтвердженням. А також можливість трансферу робочих днів та days off по державних святах України.
— Веселі тімбілдінги та корпоративні подорожі Україною та Європою.
— Допомога в релокації, оплата коворкінгів або допомога у придбанні зарядних станцій для комфортної роботи під час відключення електропостачання (після 3х місяців співпраці).
— Різноманітні можливості для навчання: доповіді спікерів у різних напрямах, велика корпоративна бібліотека, компенсація зовнішніх курсів і, звичайно, уроки англійської мови + speaking clubs (після випробувального терміну).
— Внутрішня корпоративна валюта Boosta coins.
— Але найголовніше: Honeytech — це команда професіоналів, де кожний відчуває підтримку та досягає своїх цілей!

Якщо ти побачив у рядках вище себе — надсилай нам своє резюме та приєднуйся до нашої команди, щоб разом створювати креативи, що приносять максимальний результат бізнесу!
